title: Lewat Harmoni
subject: a Jakarta commuter on TransJakarta who teaches the woman standing beside him how to transfer at Harmoni from the Blok M line to the Kalideres line, every morning for two weeks, until one day they both stay on the bus past Harmoni on purpose
caption: Indonesian Gen-Z romantic pop duet, laid-back mid-tempo groove. Bright nylon-string acoustic guitar strumming syncopated chords, muted funk electric guitar picking sixteenths, warm Rhodes pads, round finger-played electric bass, light live drums with a soft shaker. Clean, airy, close-miked production with small-room warmth. Male light tenor and female soft alto trading lines conversationally, joining in unison on the chorus. 98 BPM, D major. Giddy, shy and teasing. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no dangdut kendang, no orchestral swells.
lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar and Rhodes, shaker enters]

[Verse 1 - Male]
Halte Blok M, jam tujuh kurang lima
Kamu pegang peta, kebalik pula
Mau ke Kalideres, katamu ragu
Turun di Harmoni, ikut aku

[Verse 2 - Female]
Jembatannya panjang, tangganya licin
Kamu jalan duluan, nengok ke belakang
Besoknya aku pura-pura lupa lagi
Kamu jelasin lagi, sabar banget

[Pre-Chorus - Duet]
Udah dua minggu, kamu masih nanya
Aku tahu, aku tahu, kamu hafal juga

[Chorus - Duet]
Turun di Harmoni, pindah koridor
Naik jembatan, belok kiri, jangan salah antre
Kamu hafal jalannya, aku hafal suaramu
Besok pagi, ajarin aku lagi

[Verse 3 - Male]
Senin pagi, pintu kebuka di Harmoni
Kamu nggak berdiri, aku juga diam
Pintunya nutup, kita sampai Kota
Sama-sama telat, sama-sama ketawa

[Chorus - Duet]
Lewat Harmoni, nggak pindah koridor
Biar telat, biar kena tegur bos
Kamu hafal jalannya, aku hafal suaramu
Besok pagi, kita lewat lagi

[Outro - nylon guitar alone, Rhodes fades]
